page-structure.evidence: Title 'o11 - The AI Agent Inside Every App' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Heading tree: h1 → h2 → h3 structure is coherent with no level skips. hasMain=true, hasNav=true. However: 6 of 7 role=region landmarks have no aria-label/aria-labelledby (axe landmark-unique best-practice; unlabelled duplicate regions cannot be distinguished by landmark navigation — 1.3.1 programmatic structure concern). One region is labelled 'Scrolling content'. Missing h1 is NOT present — h1 exists ('The AI Agent Inside Every App.'). Best-practice gap: 6 unlabelled region landmarks.
